finding_resolved.description: Initial startup chronology allowed staging/launch before issuance review completed.
finding_resolved.resolution: Reviewed source requires accepted issue completion <= stage start <= stage end <= launch <= session <= observation <= owner receipt <= completion <= startup review.

limitations: Synthetic fixtures substitute explicit source/scalar bytes and clocks; actual data acceptance remains the independent auditor invocation by transition_review. Startup is not scientific completion; eventual original tool exits and stopped native closure remain required.
scope: Source review and pure in-memory synthetic tests only. Actual issuance/startup data were not audited by this reviewer.
static_checks: Import has no native operation or live clock read; explicit synthetic checked_at and monotonic accepted.
Local sha refuses scientific array and checkpoint suffixes.
JSON parsing rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite values.
Package manifest and all listed package members are byte-bound.
Accepted issuance auditor source is byte-bound.
Prepared inputs and original operator binding are byte-bound.
Phase requires root issuance, no reset, exactly600/11760/3600seconds.
Original UTC/monotonic anchor and five-second live review margin are enforced.
Global stop retains full evaluation, analysis and fifteen-second tail.
Exact completed both-role issuance receipt is consumed without rerunning issuance.
All accepted issuance evidence is rehashed and retained for final rehash.
Completion receipt binds both owner-observation hashes and same original phase.
Actual releases are byte-bound to accepted issuance review.
Staging binds accepted independent review, exact release, action, role and original stop.
Staging transport requires reaped successful exit without timeout or signals.
Original launch argv, release SHA shell gate, environment and phase are exact.
Original evaluation SSH alias and command preserve03:00 evaluation stop and closure obligation.
Original tool sessions require unique positive strict integer identifiers recorded by root.
Original tool response must bind exact session and show no exit code.
Owner observation receipt binds original session and exact native capture.
Native capture must equal raw helper stdout apart from explicit root-reference field.
Observation stderr must be empty and is included in evidence hashes.
Observed SSH command must carry exact frozen isolated helper under bounded native timeout.
Native-observation transport requires success, reap, no signals/timeout and same original stop.
Full chronology connects issue completion, stage start/end, launch, session, native probe, owner receipt and completion.
Capture role, host, release and complete immutable input SHA map are exact.
Native/root clock freshness, same boot and original phase are enforced.
Isolated helper runtime, Python identity, native binary hashes and enforced environment are checked.
Historical absence is strict boolean and other matching science list must be empty.
Owner/child native PID, PPID, PGID, SID and start_ticks are positive strict integers with exact executable.
Owner argv is exact and historical PID reuse is rejected.
Children must be unique exact released commands parented by owner, each with own native group/session.
All four GPU UUIDs are exact; child compute maps to its command GPU; foreign assigned compute is rejected.
Both roles required and scientific completion/admission claims remain false.
All four completed-original-evaluation artifacts per role must be absent.
Main rehashes every collected evidence path, repeats deadline and completed-evaluation guards, and exclusively publishes receipt.
